The '''Mark 5 comm scrambler''' was a model of [[Scrambler/Legends|scrambler]] manufactured by [[Chedak Communications]] and sold for 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire" />
